channel.title: Applied Linguistics — Calls for Papers & Conferences
channel.description: Aggregated, filtered feed of calls for papers and conference announcements relevant to applied linguistics, crawled and pulled from LINGUIST List, Ling Alert, WikiCFP and other sources.

item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: The Journal on Ethnopolitics and Minority Issues in Europe - "Special Issue: Kurdish and European Minority Language Translation in Dialogue" (Jrnl)
item.description: Translation into and out of minority languages in Europe and the Middle East operates under conditions of asymmetric institutional recognition, fragmented standardization, and uneven access to publication and broadcast infrastructures. For Kurdish communities across Iran, Iraq, Turkey, and Syria, as well as in European diasporas, translation constitutes a site where language policy, state power, and minority identity converge. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: 20th European Conference on Formal Description of Slavic Languages
item.description: Formal Description of Slavic Languages (FDSL) is a forum for researchers and scholars to present their linguistic work and discuss issues related to the formal description of Slavic languages. It covers a wide range of disciplines, including phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics, and pragmatics, and also including theoretical, experimental and corpus approaches. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Conference Announcements] Confs: 5th Argumentation & Language Conference
item.description: ARGAGE 2027 focuses on human argumentation across languages and cultures, linking linguistics, pragmatics, rhetoric, discourse analysis, and communication sciences. Key topics include argumentative styles, cultural implicatures, syntactic constructions, argumentation patterns, linguistic education, and intercultural dialogue. item.description: We are delighted to announce that the Journal of Experimental Pragmatics is now live! Built by and for the research community, JXPrag combines transparent peer review, a novel Voluntary Action Editor model, and free publishing for authors. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: Theoretical and Applied Linguistics@ro - "Issues 1 and 2 2027" (Jrnl)
item.description: We invite you to submit a paper or a book review to the journal Theoretical and Applied Linguistics@ro, edited by the Department of Linguistics of the Faculty of Letters (University of Bucharest) in collaboration with Bucharest University Press. TAL@ro is designed as a comprehensive and dynamic platform aimed at sparking debates and facilitating dialogue among scholars in various linguistic disciplines (e.g. phonetics, morphology, syntax, lexicology, semantics, pragmatics, sociolinguistics, etc.

item.description: Logos et Littera – Journal of Interdisciplinary Approaches to Text invites submissions for its upcoming non-thematic issue. We welcome innovative original research articles and review articles in linguistics, translation studies, LSP, terminology and literature. We encourage contributions that offer innovative insights, employ diverse methodologies, and engage with theoretical and practical dimensions. item.title: [LINGUIST List — Calls for Papers] Calls: Journal of Estonian and Finno-Ugric Linguistics - "Special Issue - From Home Language to Language of Schooling: Multilingual Students, Teachers, and Educational Change in Estonia and Beyond" (Jrnl)
item.description: Estonia continues to address the social, political, and demographic legacies of its Soviet past, most notably the dual school system, which has contributed to broader social segregation.
